vulkanmod.options.advCulling.tooltip: Use a culling algorithm that might improve performance by reducing the number of non visible chunk sections rendered.
vulkanmod.options.ao.subBlock.tooltip: ON (Sub-block): Enables smooth lighting for non full block (experimental).
vulkanmod.options.entityCulling.tooltip: Enables culling for entities on not visible sections.
vulkanmod.options.frameQueue.tooltip: Higher values might help stabilize frametime but will increase input lag.
vulkanmod.options.backfaceCulling.toolti: Culls not visible block faces on the CPU improving GPU performance. To prevent increased CPU overhead enable Indirect Draw.
vulkanmod.options.indirectDraw.tooltip: Reduces CPU overhead but might increases GPU overhead.
vulkanmod.options.uniqueOpaqueLayer.tool: Use a unique render layer for opaque terrain to improve performance.
iroh.screen.title: Iroh Settings
iroh.screen.reloadsChunks: Rebuilds the visible chunks when applied.
iroh.screen.restartPending: Some changes need a restart of the game.
iroh.reason.needsRt: needs a ray tracing capable GPU
iroh.note.mesherHook: Stored and ready; takes effect when the block mesher reads it.
iroh.note.schedulerHook: Stored and ready; Iroh currently rebuilds every changed chunk in the background, which is what ALWAYS means.
iroh.options.resolution.tooltip: Screen resolution used in exclusive fullscreen.
iroh.options.refreshRate.tooltip: Refresh rate used in exclusive fullscreen.
iroh.options.windowMode.tooltip: Windowed, borderless windowed fullscreen, or exclusive fullscreen.
iroh.options.framerateLimit.tooltip: Upper limit for the frame rate. The top setting means unlimited.
iroh.options.vsync.tooltip: Waits for the monitor to refresh before showing a frame. Removes tearing, can add input lag.
iroh.options.guiScale.tooltip: Size of the menus and the HUD. Auto picks the largest scale that fits the window.
iroh.options.gamma.tooltip: Brightness of dark areas. Moody is the vanilla default.
iroh.options.viewBobbing.tooltip: Shakes the view while you walk.
iroh.options.attackIndicator.tooltip: Where the attack cooldown is shown.
iroh.options.autosaveIndicator.tooltip: Shows an icon while the world is being saved.
iroh.options.showFps.tooltip: Shows the frame rate in the top left corner: current, average and the 1% low over the last seconds. Hidden while F3 is open.
iroh.options.renderDistance.tooltip: How many chunks around you are drawn.
iroh.options.simulationDistance.tooltip: How many chunks around you run the game (mobs, crops, redstone).
iroh.options.prioritizeChunkUpdates.tool: How chunk rebuilds are handled when a block changes near you.
iroh.options.graphics.tooltip: Fast removes some detail such as leaf transparency. Fancy is the normal look. Fabulous composites water, glass, particles, weather and clouds in a separate pass so they layer correctly, at some cost.
iroh.options.clouds.tooltip: Cloud style. Weather mods may draw their own clouds regardless.
iroh.options.ambientOcclusion.tooltip: Smooth lighting. ON (Sub-block) also smooths non full blocks (experimental).
iroh.options.biomeBlendRadius.tooltip: How far biome colours (grass, water, foliage) are blended. Higher looks smoother and costs chunk build time.
iroh.options.leavesQuality.tooltip: Fancy draws leaves with transparent holes, Fast as solid blocks. Default follows the Graphics setting.
iroh.options.entityShadows.tooltip: Draws a shadow blob under mobs and players.
iroh.options.entityDistanceScaling.toolt: How far entities are drawn, relative to the default.
iroh.options.mipmapLevels.tooltip: Smooths textures at a distance. Higher is smoother and uses a little more memory.
iroh.options.enableVignette.tooltip: The darkened screen edges in vanilla. The pack turns it off.
iroh.options.fogDistanceChunks.tooltip: Off draws terrain without fog (the pack's setting). Vanilla uses the normal fog. Fixed distances in chunks are not verified yet.
iroh.options.leafCulling.tooltip: Skips the faces deep inside trees that cannot be seen (what Cull Fewer Leaves did). Faster in forests.
iroh.options.leafCullingDepth.tooltip: How many layers of leaves must cover a face before it is skipped (fancy leaves; fast leaves always use 1). Higher looks fuller.
iroh.options.leafCullingRejection.toolti: Share of partly covered inner leaf faces that are skipped anyway, picked at random but always the same blocks. Higher is faster, trees look a little thinner from inside.
iroh.options.builderThreads.tooltip: Threads that build chunk meshes. Auto picks a number from your CPU.
iroh.options.chunkBuildDeferMode.tooltip: When a block you changed is rebuilt: Always in the background, One frame later (shows a stale chunk for at most one frame), or Zero frames (immediately, can stutter).
iroh.options.device.tooltip: Graphics card to use. Current device: %s
iroh.shaders.pack.tooltip: The shader pack the pack was set up with. Iroh will load it once shader pack support is finished.
iroh.shaders.upscaler.tooltip: Renders at a lower resolution and scales up (FSR, DLSS).
iroh.shaders.rayTracing.tooltip: Hardware ray traced lighting and reflections.
iroh.shaders.frameGeneration.tooltip: Creates extra frames between rendered ones.
iroh.advanced.configFile.tooltip: Where these settings are saved, inside the game's config folder.
iroh.advanced.cpus.tooltip: Threads the game can use. The chunk builder thread limit depends on it.
iroh.about.fork.tooltip: Iroh is a fork of VulkanMod. Most of the renderer is theirs and is used under the same licence.
iroh.about.upstream.tooltip: VulkanMod source code. Click to open.
iroh.about.licence.tooltip: GNU Lesser General Public License 3.0 only. Click to read it.
iroh.about.driver.tooltip: The driver version reported by the card.
iroh.about.vulkan.tooltip: The Vulkan version the card supports.
iroh.about.cap.rayTracingPipeline.toolti: Optional GPU feature for later Iroh versions. Detected only, nothing is enabled. (%s)
iroh.about.cap.rayQuery.tooltip: Optional GPU feature for later Iroh versions. Detected only, nothing is enabled. (%s)
iroh.about.cap.accelerationStructure.too: Optional GPU feature for later Iroh versions. Detected only, nothing is enabled. (%s)
iroh.about.cap.descriptorIndexing.toolti: Optional GPU feature for later Iroh versions. Detected only, nothing is enabled. (%s)
iroh.about.cap.bufferDeviceAddress.toolt: Optional GPU feature for later Iroh versions. Detected only, nothing is enabled. (%s)
iroh.about.cap.antiLag.tooltip: Optional GPU feature for later Iroh versions. Detected only, nothing is enabled. (%s)
iroh.about.cap.lowLatency2.tooltip: Optional GPU feature for later Iroh versions. Detected only, nothing is enabled. (%s)
iroh.about.cap.cooperativeMatrix.tooltip: Optional GPU feature for later Iroh versions. Detected only, nothing is enabled. (%s)
iroh.about.cap.float8.tooltip: Optional GPU feature for later Iroh versions. Detected only, nothing is enabled. (%s)
